name: Mysterious Stationery Shop
layout: Narrow shop interior deeper than its storefront suggests. Front door with bell; central aisle between tall shelves; wooden counter toward the back where Mira stands. A high rear shelf holds cloth-covered tools including the Inkwell. Soft clutter without hazardous mess.
key_landmarks: Front window display of paper and pens
High rear shelf with covered objects
Faint back-room curtain (implied storage; rarely entered)
furniture_objects: Cloth covers / soft wraps for special tools
Balance scale or old measuring tools (background flavor)
Small handwritten rule card near register (optional)
visual_identifiers: Warm dim interior vs brighter street outside
Smell cues via steam/dust motes and paper texture (visual only)
Objects feel older than the neighbourhood average
Inkwell shelf is sacred focal point when revealed
camera_possibilities: Low-to-high reveal of covered Inkwell shelf
Hero object insert when cloth lifts
Night sequel-hook shot of second covered tool
continuity_constraints: Door bell / threshold should recur on entries
Counter and high shelf spatial relationship stays fixed
Inkwell lives on the high shelf until lent; when returned/kept, shelf emptiness or remaining tools should make sense
Mira is strongly associated with counter space
Shop should remain recognizable between early discovery and late return scenes
